title: Energy and existence with a timelike Dirichlet boundary
source_policy: Independent exposition, complete programme proofs and exact scholarly references.

source_references.title: Lars Hörmander — The Analysis of Linear Partial Differential Operators III (reprint of 1994 edition)
source_references.reading_scope: The complete Section 24.1 treatment, Theorem 24.1.1 and Lemmas/Theorem 24.1.2-24.1.6: Lorentz geometry, weighted energy and normal flux, rough and local uniqueness, all-real adjoint estimate, dual existence and global assembly.

changes: Reconnected exact current higher-order Cauchy, two-weight/half-space, integration, duality and Hilbert representation proofs.
Used local boundary-coordinate extensions before constructing the global product flow, avoiding an unproved prior global collar.
Wrote out the full coefficient remainder of the complex flux identity.
Proved the outward graph-domain divergence formula, signs and finite-face localization directly from iterated integration.
Proved the exact H1 and zero-trace test approximations used by the weak Green identity.
Added an exact flat-boundary ray, inward multiplier and derivative-energy ellipse figure with reproducible geometry.
Corrected the source edition and PDF offset against the approved HIII copy; retained every original display and all four complete solutions.
Added the positive smooth-cutoff argument for nontransverse artificial faces and an exact dense variable-coefficient remainder check.
